_comment: THE EPSTEIN-MAXWELL RECORD - the third b0b.dev film, built by scripts/build-intro-collage.py --spec scripts/film-epstein-maxwell.json.
Its argument is Section II's and V's, at their tiers: the documented record (the 1991 power of attorney, the 1996 FBI
complaint record, the 2007 NPA and the OPR finding, the bank, the OIG failure stack, the conviction, the files), then the
report's conclusion stated as such (rung 4, both principals), the sponsor named only as the author's hypothesis
(Mossad directing, US and UK services witting by liaison, argued from structure not from the files), rung 5 claimed
for no one. Author's calls, 24 Sept 2026: both tiers in; people named only for acts on paper (Wexner's power of
attorney; Acosta in the OPR finding).

HARD RULES, applied to picture and word (also: no ERC-1155 frame with a face - three were swapped out; the House hearing-room clip was cut because its 2011 members are identifiable; the Spirit of Justice statue was cut because its child figure, under a line about the abuse, reads as depicting a victim): no survivor named or shown; no image of any living uncharged person; nothing
from the EFTA releases, court exhibits or evidence opened or used; no residence shown; the NPA is quoted from the OPR
summary, which counts the named co-conspirators without naming them. Faces: Robert Maxwell (d. 1991) at a 1989 public
panel (Anefo, CC0); Epstein (d. 2019) only in the 2006 Palm Beach County Sheriff booking photograph (PD, Florida).
Fact-checked 24 Sept 2026 (scratchpad film3-facts.md): Maxwell "vanished", not "went overboard"; >GBP 400m from the
pension funds (GBP 426m of GBP 526m); Ghislaine's 1991 move month unsupported; the 1996 FBI record documented, the
NYPD report her account; OPR "poor judgment" quoted; the CVRA ruling "failing to advise"; JPMorgan ~$1.3bn reported
only after the 2019 arrest; OIG "did not uncover evidence contradicting the FBI's determination regarding the absence
of criminality"; Baden retained by the family; the body "claimed", not identified; "in the United States" only two

lines.text: Robert Maxwell. A Military Cross in 1945; from 1951, Pergamon Press - scientific publishing that crossed the Iron Curtain.
lines.say: Robert Maxwell. A Military Cross in nineteen forty-five; from nineteen fifty-one, Pergamon Press: scientific publishing that crossed the Iron Curtain.

lines.text: In 1971 government inspectors wrote that he was not a person who could be relied on to exercise proper stewardship of a publicly quoted company.
lines.say: In nineteen seventy-one, government inspectors wrote that he was not a person who could be relied on to exercise proper stewardship of a publicly quoted company.

lines.text: On 5 November 1991 he vanished from his yacht off the Canary Islands. Within weeks, more than four hundred million pounds was found missing from his companies’ pension funds.
lines.say: On the fifth of November, nineteen ninety-one, he vanished from his yacht off the Canary Islands. Within weeks, more than four hundred million pounds was found missing from his companies’ pension funds.

lines.text: He was buried on the Mount of Olives. The President of Israel gave the eulogy.

shots.text: he is not in our opinion a person who can be relied on to exercise proper stewardship of a publicly quoted company.

lines.text: In July 1991 Leslie Wexner gave Epstein power of attorney: to sign cheques, hire, and buy and sell property in his name.
lines.say: In July nineteen ninety-one, Leslie Wexner gave Epstein power of attorney: to sign cheques, hire, and buy and sell property in his name.

lines.text: 1991 is when Epstein became useful. It is no evidence of when, or whether, anyone recruited him.
lines.say: Nineteen ninety-one is when Epstein became useful. It is no evidence of when, or whether, anyone recruited him.

shots.head: 1991 · one year, on paper
shots.tag: UPI (MAR, NOV 1991) · FRANKLIN COUNTY POWER OF ATTORNEY, AS REPORTED · SECTIONS II AND V
rows: ROBERT MAXWELL BUYS THE NEW YORK DAILY NEWS
GHISLAINE MAXWELL MOVES TO NEW YORK

lines.text: In September 1996 the FBI logged a complaint about Epstein. It stayed out of public view until the Justice Department released it in December 2025.
lines.say: In September nineteen ninety-six, the F B I logged a complaint about Epstein. It stayed out of public view until the Justice Department released it in December twenty twenty-five.

lines.text: Nothing followed for nine years.

shots.head: The first record
shots.tag: FBI COMPLAINT RECORD, STAMPED 3 SEPT 1996 · RELEASED DEC 2025 (BOSTON GLOBE; HOUSE OVERSIGHT)

lines.text: Palm Beach, 2005: police open a case. In September 2007 federal prosecutors agree to end their investigation, and to forgo prosecuting him, four named co-conspirators, and any potential co-conspirators.
lines.say: Palm Beach, two thousand and five: police open a case. In September two thousand and seven, federal prosecutors agree to end their investigation, and to forgo prosecuting him, four named co-conspirators, and any potential co-conspirators.

lines.text: In 2008 he pleads guilty to two state charges, and serves less than thirteen months, much of it on work release.
lines.say: In two thousand and eight he pleads guilty to two state charges, and serves less than thirteen months, much of it on work release.

lines.text: In 2019 a federal judge rules that prosecutors violated the victims’ rights law by failing to tell them of the deal. In 2020 the Justice Department’s own review found that the US Attorney, Alexander Acosta, had shown poor judgment.
lines.say: In twenty nineteen, a federal judge rules that prosecutors violated the victims’ rights law by failing to tell them of the deal. In twenty twenty, the Justice Department’s own review found that the U S Attorney, Alexander Acosta, had shown poor judgment.

shots.head: DOJ Office of Professional Responsibility · Nov 2020
shots.tag: DOJ OPR REPORT, EXECUTIVE SUMMARY (NOV 2020) · PD
shots.text: the USAO agreed to end its investigation of Epstein and to forgo federal prosecution in the Southern District of Florida of him, four named co-conspirators, and “any potential co-conspirators.”

shots.head: The finding
shots.tag: DOJ OPR REPORT, EXECUTIVE SUMMARY (NOV 2020) · PD
shots.text: Acosta’s decision to resolve the federal investigation through the NPA constitutes poor judgment.

lines.text: JPMorgan banked him for fifteen years, and kept him through two waves of red flags.
lines.say: J P Morgan banked him for fifteen years, and kept him through two waves of red flags.

lines.text: Only after his arrest in 2019 did it file reports flagging about one point three billion dollars in transfers.
lines.say: Only after his arrest, in twenty nineteen, did it file reports flagging about one point three billion dollars in transfers.

lines.text: It settled with his victims for two hundred and ninety million dollars, and with the Virgin Islands for seventy-five, admitting no liability.

shots.head: The bank · the record
shots.tag: USVI v. JPMORGAN, JANE DOE 1 v. JPMORGAN (SDNY) · SENATE FINANCE (NOV 2025) · JPM 10-Q Q3 2023
rows: AFTER HIS ARREST: ~$1.3BN IN TRANSFERS REPORTED
$290M TO VICTIMS · $75M TO USVI · NO ADMISSION

lines.text: July 2019: arrested again, on federal sex-trafficking charges. On 10 August he was found dead in his cell.
lines.say: July, twenty nineteen: arrested again, on federal sex-trafficking charges. On the tenth of August he was found dead in his cell.

lines.text: The Inspector General found: a written direction to give him a cellmate ignored; half the cameras not recording; no rounds for hours; records falsified.
The medical examiner ruled suicide. A pathologist retained by the family disputes it. The ruling stands; the dissent is recorded.

States can move a person and give him a new name; that is on the record. What this record holds instead is an autopsy observed by the family’s own pathologist, and a family arguing murder, not survival.
In 2025 the Justice Department released raw footage of that night. It had been assembled from at least two clips. The editing is documented; what it hides, if anything, is not.
lines.say: In twenty twenty-five, the Justice Department released raw footage of that night. It had been assembled from at least two clips. The editing is documented; what it hides, if anything, is not.

shots.head: DOJ Inspector General · Report 23-085 · June 2023
rows: RECORDING SYSTEM FAILS · ABOUT HALF THE CAMERAS DARK
WRITTEN DIRECTION: ASSIGN HIM A CELLMATE
NO ROUNDS AFTER ~10:40 PM · COUNTS MISSED
FOUND NOTHING CONTRADICTING THE FBI’S NO-CRIMINALITY FINDING

lines.text: Ghislaine Maxwell was convicted in December 2021 on five counts, including sex trafficking of a minor, and sentenced to twenty years.
lines.say: Ghislaine Maxwell was convicted in December twenty twenty-one on five counts, including sex trafficking of a minor, and sentenced to twenty years.

lines.text: In July 2025 the Deputy Attorney General interviewed her for two days under limited immunity. A week later she was moved to a minimum-security prison camp.
lines.say: In July twenty twenty-five, the Deputy Attorney General interviewed her for two days under limited immunity. A week later she was moved to a minimum-security prison camp.

lines.text: In November 2025 Congress ordered the files released. The Department has published nearly three and a half million pages.
lines.say: In November twenty twenty-five, Congress ordered the files released. The Department has published nearly three and a half million pages.

lines.text: In the United States, only two people have ever been charged over the abuse. One of them is dead.
The records that would settle what else this was are service files, and they are withheld from everyone. A silence that is certain to occur proves nothing either way.
This report’s conclusion: both functioned as deniable assets. Rung four.
It names a sponsor only as a hypothesis: Mossad directing, with American and British services witting by liaison - argued from documented structure, not from the files.
Rung five, tasked and run, is claimed for no one.
